items.label: Coffee's share of Guming's revenue, H1 2026
Guming's daily coffee target per store for 2026 (about 80 at end-2025)

notes: By June 2026 about 13,500 Guming stores had coffee machines, about 94% of the network. Mixue is following: its fresh-ground coffee machines reached more than 3,000 stores by end-June and more than 6,000 by 27 August, with about 14,000 planned by year end.
footnote: Source: Guming interim results and earnings call (Aug 2026)
